entries.title: API keys offer the scopes they really have
entries.description: Creating an API key now offers Read and Write, the two scopes a key is checked against. A Read key can only look things up; a Write key can also start runs and change records.

entries.title: Account ids and SSN last fours are masked
entries.description: A value named as an SSN, an account, a card or a tax ID, such as an SSN's last four or an account id like BUS-7781, is now masked in chat, on a run's page, on a batch's page and in its results download, and in logs, numbers included. In Human Tasks, whoever may decide a task sees its real values to check them; anyone else who can open it sees them masked.
